description: Checksum-verified baseline evidence for the current-main QEMU boot through the recovered Phase 15 TCG backend. This package documents what CAN run (current-main kernel + userspace + desktop presentation through genuine QEMU). It does NOT include V1 graphical guest execution (P-1..P-4, N-1..N-14), which is blocked pending ADR-0114 acceptance and Desktop Identify implementation.

serial-main.log.description: Full UEFI→kernel→userspace serial boot log, including shutdown and UEFI ResetSystem(shutdown) halt

BOOTX64.EFI.description: EFI extracted from the booted ESP (EFI/BOOT/BOOTX64.EFI)

evidence.json.description: Original evidence manifest from the boot run

emulator_binary.description: QEMU 11.1.2, TCG only (-accel tcg), locally modified (patch SHA c2909ea9…), matches docs/phase15/ACCEPTANCE.md and manifest.json

emulator_binary_unpatched.description: Unpatched QEMU control binary (backend-control expected-fail target)

isolated_glibc_libc.description: Isolated glibc 2.40 C library, built via tools/dev-env/build-isolated-glibc.sh

isolated_glibc_ldso.description: Isolated glibc 2.40 dynamic loader, used by QEMU wrappers

ovmf_vars_template.description: OVMF VARS template (fresh copy per boot)

current_main_esp.description: Current-main d2bfd66 ESP, produced by tools/build.sh --image in a prior bind-mounted workspace run; survives at /workspace/ArenaOS/build/

current_main_efi.description: EFI extracted from the booted ESP; also packaged as BOOTX64.EFI in this package

qemu_qualification_archive.description: Not duplicated here; referenced by committed identity. Source of the recovered QEMU binaries and firmware.
